# mv: rename a var in a grouped var declaration (removeDecl multi-spec)
mv X Z
-- x.go --
package m

var (
	X = 1
	Y = 2
)

func F() int { return X }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,8 +1,8 @@
 package m

 var (
-	X = 1
+	Z = 1
 	Y = 2
 )

-func F() int { return X }
+func F() int { return Z }
